remarks: BEST & FINAL OFFERS BY TUES, JAN. 20TH AT 1:00 PM* PLEASE SEE DETAILS IN CONFIDENTIAL AGENT REMARKS.  Discover your next home at 83 Woodridge Dr S, where smart living meets casual elegance. This impeccably maintained 4-bedroom, 3-bath haven spans 2,310 square feet, offering a spacious layout with bright sunny rooms and a primary bedroom with en-suite bath. First floor standouts include a beautifully upgraded kitchen, warm comfortable family room, and stylishly appointed living and dining room. In addition to the primary bedroom suite, there are two other secondary bedrooms that share a full bath. The lower level boasts a guest/in-law suite with a full bath, in-home office, separate laundry room, plus a large common tv area perfect for Super Bowl fans, complete with direct garage access. Outside, you'll find a newly constructed large patio with a fire pit and ample space for additional seating and outdoor dining. In this tightly-knit neighborhood, where residents look out for each other and celebrate holidays with abundance, you'll truly embrace the sentiment, "I love where we live!"
